translations.web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
translations.bsb: I will be partial to no one, nor will I flatter any man.
translations.kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
translations.asv: Let me not, I pray you, respect any man's person; Neither will I give flattering titles unto any man.
